decision_summary.summary: Observed facts: depth_check failed with DEPTH_INSUFFICIENT (measured_y_um=5.4839 vs required >=8.0, mask_vertical_scanline, per failure signal and event-0018); depth_mill previously succeeded (event-0012) using the 3-rectangle depth_mill recipe whose geometry is immutable per constraints. Unknown: exact mapping from additional FIB depth to compensated measured Y (1:1 vs 1/sin(55deg)); shortfall is 2.516 um measured. Strategy: mill_more with depth_increment_um=3.0 per rectangle on recipe depth_mill, which covers the 2.516 um shortfall with margin under either mapping (~8.48 um if 1:1, ~9.17 um if tilt-compensated), without altering rectangle geometry. Then acquire a fresh ELECTRON side-view at the same 50 um HFW used by the original depth_image, detect the 'sample' target at a 0.5 confidence threshold, and run verify_depth on that fresh post-mutation detection so the final measurement reflects the new state (a pre-mutation detection cannot establish the final depth). Budget fits: 1 recovery image acquisition and 4 actions within limits.
